_comment: Claim 15 at the paper's full scale (Fig. 5; App. E.4 table): parametric softmax with 2,560,000 trained keys of width 3,072 and 10-dim values, all 50,000 CIFAR-10 training images with augmentation, batch 64, Adam 3e-3 (lowest rate of the paper's grid), T = 1, plain softmax (fixed equal weights). bf16 parameters and first Adam moment, fp32 second moment (78.6 GB with the fused kernel in rcdl/triton_adam.py; all-fp32 state would need about 126 GB). A bf16 second moment stalls training (docs/REPRODUCTION.md section 7.7); add --set bf16_stochastic_rounding=true (round to nearest loses small Adam steps). The paper trains 2,000 epochs (about 63 GPU-hours at 113 s per epoch on an RTX PRO 6000); the run is stopped when its time budget is used. The defaults below evaluate every 5 epochs on 2,000 test and 2,000 non-augmented training images; the fourth-round run used --run-set eval_every=1562 eval_subset=10000 (every 2 epochs, all 10,000 test images).
